basis: AXT’s February 16, 2023 release verifies consolidated Q4 2022 revenue of $26,795,000 against $37,732,000 in Q4 2021. The 95% cutoff was $35,845,400. October 27, 2022 is the earliest specific candidate found: a third-party transcript attributes a $26 million–$29 million Q4 revenue forecast to CFO Gary Fischer. The issuer’s written release omits that forecast, and I could not verify the spoken figures from the recording or another primary document. The linked exhibit establishes the actual result. The earliest public disclosure date remains unresolved.

coverage.detail: July 28 Q2 earnings release. AXT discussed growth opportunities without giving a numeric Q4 consolidated revenue ceiling. Its subsequent October 3 exhibit explicitly identifies the July guidance as $39 million–$41 million for Q3.

The secondary Q2 call record identifies three additional events to check: BWS Financial on August 23, Needham Virtual SemiCap on August 24 and Jefferies in Chicago on August 30. The earlier review found Q4 uncertainty on the July call. Searches did not recover primary AXT remarks establishing what management said at those August events.

Located a third-party index of all 16 slides of AXT’s August 22 presentation. Slide 11 shows historical revenue through Q2 2022. The visible excerpts contain no Q4 revenue forecast. An issuer-hosted full copy was not recovered.
October 3 preliminary release cut expected revenue to $34 million–$35 million specifically for the quarter ended September 30. Both this range and the July range it updated apply to Q3.

October 27 earnings exhibit reported $35,183,000 of Q3 revenue and announced that afternoon’s call. Its Q4 timing discussion concerned subsidiary Tongmei’s proposed listing. The exhibit gives no consolidated Q4 sales ceiling.
AXT’s event record dates the public call to October 27 at 4:30 p.m. ET and links to the webcast. The page contains no prepared remarks, slides or revenue range.
Followed AXT’s exact webcast link. The host returned a page with zero readable lines. I could not retrieve a recording or host transcript to verify Fischer’s guidance.
The archive lookup for the exact webcast URL was inaccessible. Whether a playable historical capture exists remains unknown.
The separate telephone-registration link in AXT’s October 27 release was also inaccessible. It supplied no verifiable call content.

The secondary transcript attributes to Fischer the words “we expect Q4 revenue to be between $26 million and $29 million,” followed by separate earnings guidance. It also reports that AXT intended to host the replay through October 27, 2023. The transcript was readable, but the audio itself was not verified.

Checked the conference host for the November 17, 2022 Alpha Select event identified in the Q3 call transcript. I found no archived AXT recording, transcript or presentation on the host’s public events page. The content of AXT’s remarks remains unverified.
AXT’s December 28 announcement scheduled Fischer’s Needham presentation for January 11, 2023 at 3:45 p.m. ET. It gives no Q4 revenue figure.
AXT’s event listing displays January 12 at 3:45 p.m. ET, one day later than its dated announcement. The listing provides a webcast link but no financial remarks.

The issuer-linked Wall Street Webcasting host redirected to registration and identified AXT’s presentation as January 11 at 3:45 p.m. ET, agreeing with the December announcement. No recording, slides or transcript were accessible on that page.
The January 25 scheduling notice announced the February 16 results release without giving preliminary Q4 revenue.

February 16 actuals. The consolidated statements of operations show revenue, in thousands, of 26,795 and 37,732 in the three-month columns ended December 31, 2022 and 2021. Both values use AXT’s reported consolidated perimeter.

publication_date_evidence: AXT’s October 27 release and IR event record establish the public call date and time. Only secondary transcripts supplied the candidate numeric ceiling. AXT’s results exhibit is expressly datelined February 16, 2023 and reports both quarterly actuals. That verifies when AXT published the result while leaving the earlier guidance date open.
primary_source_reason: Secondary transcript identified during the frozen scorers post-lock source review. The dated evidence must be verifiable on a primary issuer source.
